cues: The two NADH from glycolysis are made in the cytoplasm, and cannot cross into the mitochondrion.
A shuttle carries their electrons in.
The malate aspartate shuttle delivers them to complex one, worth two point five each: thirty-two.
The glycerol phosphate shuttle delivers them to ubiquinone, worth one point five each: thirty.
So the modern answer is thirty to thirty-two ATP per glucose.
